allow: PowerShell($appdata = $env:APPDATA; Get-ChildItem "$appdata\\luarocks" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 FullName; Get-ChildItem "C:\\LuaRocks", "C:\\Lua", "C:\\lua" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 FullName)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\Lua", "C:\\ProgramData\\Lua", "C:\\dev" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10 FullName; [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path", "User"\) -split ";" | Where-Object { $_ -match "lua" })

PowerShell($env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","User"\) + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","Machine"\); $lua = \(Get-Command lua\).Source; luarocks --local config variables.LUA "$lua" 2>&1; luarocks --local install luaunit 2>&1)
